
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Divides elements of a one-dimensional single-precision complex floating-
    point ndarray by the corresponding elements of a second one-dimensional
    single-precision complex floating-point ndarray and assigns the results to
    elements in a third one-dimensional single-precision complex floating-point
    ndarray.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing the following ndarrays:

        - first one-dimensional input ndarray.
        - second one-dimensional input ndarray.
        - a one-dimensional output ndarray.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var xbuf = [ 4.0, 6.0, 12.0, 8.0 ];
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/complex64}}( xbuf );
    > var ybuf = [ 1.0, 1.0, 2.0, 2.0 ];
    > var y = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/complex64}}( ybuf );
    > var w = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/complex64}}( 2 );
    > {{alias}}( [ x, y, w ] )
    <ndarray>[ <Complex64>[ 5.0, 1.0 ], <Complex64>[ 5.0, -1.0 ] ]

    See Also
    --------
